title: A nine-step M&A roadmap
rows: Preparation: evaluate business operations and financials
Initial business valuation with the most reliable method and an external consultant
Initial contacts with potential buyer or seller
Letter of intent: proposed price, structure and contingencies
Negotiate purchase agreement: price, representations, warranties and closing conditions
Post-transaction actions: integration, covenants and purchase-price allocation
